claims.text: Translation between Arabic and Spanish is explored using pivoting through English.
The Europarl corpus evaluates language pairs such as French-English-Spanish, German-English-French, and Romanian-English-German.
Multilingual NMT supports translation from multiple source languages into multiple target languages, including unseen pairs.
